items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I was born there in a nursing home. But my home and where I grew up was a little town four miles from there called Dalry

ctx.x: You’re from Scotland, and I don’t know if I can pronounce — I’ll try — Kilwinning?

Well yeah. I was only there very briefly. I was born there in a nursing home. But my home and where I grew up was a little town four miles from there called Dalry, and that’s where I grew up before I moved into Glasgow when I was a student.
